answer: Mechanism: VDF Time-Bridge. A global verifiable-delay spiral issues one identity slot per fixed epoch; each new agent must extend the latest beacon with a unique sequential proof at its assigned height and bridge its public key to the prior slot. Peers verify the proof reaches the epoch’s zenith before accepting messages. An attacker’s N Sybil identities need N distinct sequential slots, so cost is elapsed wall-clock time and serial computation, not capital; proofs cannot be batched, reused, or bought ahead.
